_meta.purpose: Canonical 4-domain priority map for the Safety portal. Drives the Safety Sidebar V2 domain order, the Safety Hub tile stripe palette, and any future Safety re-tier decisions. Mirrors HR_INFORMATION_PRIORITY_MAP.json discipline.
_meta.verification: VERIFIED · matches frontend/src/components/safety/sidebar/SafetySideNavV2.jsx and the post-iter437-IV-BETA.5A SafetyHub tile palette
_meta.doctrine: Reserve red for incidents/escalation only. False urgency must disappear so true urgency stays unmistakable.

domains.label: Incidents & Escalation
domains.subline: Active incidents, near misses, corrective action closure.
domains.rationale: Highest operational severity. The ONE red domain. Owns true urgency signalling so the rest of the portal can stay calm.

domains.label: Documents & Training
domains.rationale: Day-to-day operational reference surfaces. Cyan stripe carries the Safety brand chrome without competing with red.

domains.label: Compliance & Records
domains.subline: Expirations, fire extinguishers, weekly digest, reports.
domains.rationale: Read-mostly compliance and record-keeping surfaces. Violet differentiates from urgent red and operational cyan.

domains.label: Audits & Guidance
domains.subline: Inspections, topic prep, fleet visibility, operator guides.
domains.rationale: Lowest-frequency surfaces. Slate communicates 'support, not operations' — visually demoted on the Hub.

doctrine_compliance.verbiage_doctrine: All labels and sublines pass verify_admin_copy.py — no banned phrases.
doctrine_compliance.coaching_standard: All sublines ≤14 words, sentence-cased, end with period.
doctrine_compliance.loudness: Four stripe colours total (red · cyan · violet · slate); chrome stays slate-900. Single neutral slate-800 CTA across Hub tiles.
doctrine_compliance.escalation_contract: Red reserved for incidents/escalation domain + severity pills + severe-tier banners. All other domains demoted.
doctrine_compliance.auth_routing: Safety portal already audited clean — see PORTAL_AUTH_TOKEN_AUDIT.md §3.x. No /api/admin/* calls from Safety context.
